profile.name: Mohammad Danish Khan
profile.summary: Senior Account Manager and Hybrid Account Executive with 11+ years of experience in B2B sales, enterprise account management, lead generation, CRM-driven operations, and multi-industry client engagement across technology, manufacturing, education, and government sectors. Consistently recognized with performance awards including Dell President Club (APJ & GC Region). Expert in sales strategy, customer segmentation, cross-functional collaboration, team leadership, and revenue growth execution.
profile.title: Senior Account Manager / Hybrid Account Executive

key_skills.Sales Leadership & Strategy: Expert in driving enterprise, government, and education sales with consistent achievement of 120–150% YoY growth and multi-million-dollar pipelines.

key_skills.Lead Generation & Demand Building: Strong experience in generating targeted B2B leads, executing outreach campaigns, and running data-backed sales funnels for technology and industrial products.

key_skills.Client Relationship Management: Built and managed high-value client portfolios, strengthened long-term relationships, and maintained high retention across 5000+ accounts.

key_skills.Cross-functional Collaboration: Worked with product, finance, technical, marketing, and operations teams to align revenue strategies and execute customer-focused initiatives.

key_skills.Sales Operations & Analytics: Proficient in CRM management, forecasting, sales reporting, account prioritization, and performance analytics.

key_skills.Negotiation & Deal Closure: Led enterprise negotiations, prepared proposals, managed pricing strategies, and ensured compliance with company policies.

key_skills.Team Leadership: Managed and mentored tele-sales and inside-sales teams to improve performance, pipeline generation, and customer engagement.

key_skills.Technical Pre-sales & Industrial Domain: Experience across automation, engineering, food, pharma, chemical, and automotive segments with hands-on technical integration roles early in career.
